description: Boundary case. Chosen so the Moon sits close to a nakshatra edge, which is where Vimshottari balance-at-birth and the D30/D60 non-equal divisions are most likely to flip. A rounding regression that leaves the other fixtures intact should surface here first.

referenceSource.doctrine: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra (R. Santhanam translation), C23_BPHS_Santhanam.pdf

locators.vargas: Ch.6, including the non-equal D30 (Trimsamsa) and D60 (Shashtiamsa) rules

review.note: Values recorded from this repository's own engine to detect drift. Not yet signed off against an independent published chart; see fixtures/README.md.
